GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 4 lengths. well back turn looking for run. held up early in Straight . got to outside 200 metres. ran on strongly to just miss # unlucky
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Was held up rounding the home turn and in the early part of the straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Touch slow away. Not pushed early & raced behind Mid Field Two Wide (5L from lead). Improved 1 length midrace & 3 Wide @ 600m. Held up Four Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Four Wide @ 300m & gave ground Four Wide in last 200m. # didn't quicken
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Was held up for clear running in the early part of the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat box seat 1 length off, off rail turn, Straightened Up 1 length off, plodded home # weak run home
Jumped Ok eased from barrier to last 10 lengths. well back turn. hooked Wide in Straight . ran on strongly # good from barrier
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned, rider advised that her instructions were to obtain a forward position, however from the outside gate and when her mount did not show its customary speed, rather than risk being trapped wide, she elected to take up a position further back in the field, closer to the rail.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th 2 lengths. hooked 3 Wide turn 3 lengths. ran on well # Every Chance

Jumped Fast Restrained Settled Down Run Of Race 3rd Inside 2 Lengths No Pace On only 1 Lengths off winner, Ridden Along Turning for home clear run home couldn't quicken Couldn'T Go On x 200m, # had all favours
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the 800m had to be checked from heels when the speed slackened from the race.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 3rd 2 lengths. hooked 3 Wide turn 2 lengths. ran on well. looked winner # Every Chance
Jumped Ok Settled Down outside leader. 2nd turn under pressure. dropped out # poor
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping. When questioned, rider advised that with blinkers applied to her mount today, the gelding over-raced badly and consequently weakened inside the final 250m. She further added that upon pulling up after the race, her mount made respiratory noises. A post-race veterinary examination of the gelding did not reveal any abnormality.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well faced breeze 1 length off, pushed along turn, Straightened Up half off, kept on well b4 run ended 100m and gave ground late # weak final 100m
Jumped Ok faced breeze 1 length clear, pushed along a touch turn, Straightened Up half off, same 200m, same 100m, kept on strong to the line just no match leader/winner # breeze/leader won
Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th 3 Wide 2 lengths. 3 Wide turn under pressure. weakened. 3 Wide trip # respiratory problem
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing 900m was inconvenienced and taken in by another runner. Raced three-wide throughout. When questioned, rider said her mount was agitated prior to the race and did not travel at any stage of the event and was disappointing in its failure to respond to her riding in the straight. A post-race vet exam revealed to have a nasal charge indicative of onset of a respiratory infection. Vet clearance received.
